headlines: Alphabet down ~13% after results; capex guide $195-205B
US Q3 GDP advance 3.4% vs 2.2% prior; deflator 2.2%

rumors.text: SPY will drop hard after hours on Amazon results
rumors.why: A weak AMZN print after Alphabet's drop could extend the megacap tech selloff.

rumors.text: Alphabet is under the SEC Rule 201 short-sale restriction after its drop
rumors.why: A circuit breaker after a 10%+ fall limits shorting and shows heavy selling pressure.

rumors.text: The market rotation into value and small caps is a shell game, as at the Y2K top
rumors.why: If true, the small-cap bid would fade and the index would follow tech lower.

readings.whats_new: SPY is slightly weaker at 766.99 (-0.69%) than the last reading, with QQQ down 1.8% as Alphabet and ServiceNow keep sliding while small caps hold gains. Fear & greed eased to 34 and VIX to 16.3; the crowd is split about 52/48 and chatter is bouncing toward 769. Amazon after the close is still the main catalyst and the old Hormuz rumor did not resurface.
